_PAY_NOA.summary: Individuals and trusts pay as advised on the notice of assessment; for a late return, 21 days after the lodgment due date.
_PAY_NOA.unresolved: the notice of assessment, which sets the payment due date: for a return lodged on time, 21 days after the later of the lodgment due date and the day the notice is deemed received (7 business days after issue)

_PAY_IT_15MAY.summary: Staggered payment for returns due 15 May 2027: lodged by 12 February 2027, pay by 21 March 2027; lodged 13 February to 12 March 2027, by 21 April 2027; lodged from 13 March 2027, by 5 June 2027. These are the latest dates if processing takes 2 weeks; a later notice of assessment sets a later date.
_PAY_IT_15MAY.unresolved: the lodgement date and the notice of assessment, which set the payment due date

individual.summary: Self-lodged individual return: lodge by 31 October; on a weekend, the next business day.

payment.summary: A self-lodged return with a tax bill lodged by 31 October: pay by 21 November, or 21 days after the assessment issues if that is after 31 October. Lodged late: pay by 21 November.
payment.unresolved: the lodgement date and the assessment issue date: for a return lodged by 31 October whose assessment issues after 31 October, payment is 21 days after issue

trust.summary: Self-lodged trust return: lodge by 31 October.

payment.summary: Any tax assessed to the trustee is payable as advised on the notice of assessment.
payment.unresolved: the notice of assessment: the self-lodger page gives no payment date for a trust

partnership.summary: Self-lodged partnership return: lodge by 31 October. A partnership pays no income tax; the partners pay on their own returns.

_SELF_CO_HEAD.summary: The ATO's self-lodger pages publish no date for the head company of a consolidated group.
_SELF_CO_HEAD.unresolved: a self-lodger due date for a consolidated group's head company, which the ATO pages do not publish

_SELF_CO_OVERDUE.summary: Self-lodged company with prior year returns outstanding: lodge by 31 October.

payment.summary: The self-lodger page gives no payment date for this case.
payment.unresolved: whether the 1 December 2026 payment date on the agent program's overdue returns page applies to a self-lodger: that page addresses registered agents and the self-lodger page gives no payment date

_SELF_CO.summary: Self-lodged company with no prior year returns outstanding: the ATO says the date for small companies is generally 28 February and asks self-lodgers to check their date.
_SELF_CO.unresolved: which companies the self-lodger page's 28 February date covers: it applies 'generally' to 'small companies', which the page does not define

_SELF_SMSF_OCT.summary: Self-preparing SMSF that is a new registrant or has an annual return overdue at 30 June 2026 (unless deferred): lodge by 31 October 2026. The earliest applicable date applies.

_SELF_SMSF_JAN.summary: Self-preparing SMSF that was a taxable large or medium entity in 2025–26: lodge by 31 January 2027.

_SELF_SMSF_FEB.summary: All other self-preparing SMSFs: lodge and pay by 28 February 2027.

_NOT_COVERED.summary: A client added to the agent's client list after 31 October 2026 is not covered by the program for the 2026 return.
_NOT_COVERED.unresolved: the due date for a client the program does not cover, which the ATO pages do not state

_CON_PART.summary: Concession for partnership returns due 15 May 2027: lodged with any payment by 5 June 2027, no penalty applies.

new.summary: New registrant large or medium company: lodge and pay by 28 February 2027.

True.summary: Large or medium company whose 2025 return was taxable: lodge by 31 January 2027.

False.summary: Large or medium company whose 2025 return was non-taxable or not necessary: lodge and pay (if required) by 28 February 2027.

_CO_31MAR.summary: Company (not large or medium) with total income over $2 million in the latest year lodged: lodge and pay by 31 March 2027.

_CO_15MAY.summary: All remaining companies that are tax agent clients, including new registrants: lodge and pay by 15 May 2027.

_CON_CO.summary: Concession for a company or super fund return due 15 May 2027 that is non-taxable or a refund in both the prior and current year: lodged by 5 June 2027, no penalty applies.

_HEAD_FIRST.summary: A head company's first consolidated return is due on the latest date the group's notification of formation can be lodged.

False.summary: Head company (including a new registrant) of a group with a large or medium member, or large or medium under the single entity rule, whose 2026 return will be non-taxable: lodge by 28 February 2027.

_HEAD_NEW.summary: New registrant head company without a large or medium member.

_HEAD_31MAR.summary: Head company without a large or medium member, with a member whose total income exceeded $2 million in the latest year lodged: lodge and pay by 31 March 2027.

_HEAD_15MAY.summary: All other head companies: lodge and pay (if required) by 15 May 2027. The 5 June concession excludes head companies.

True.summary: Large or medium super fund, taxable in the latest year lodged: lodge by 31 January 2027.

False.summary: Large or medium super fund, non-taxable in the latest year lodged: lodge and pay (if required) by 28 February 2027.

_SMSF_NEW.summary: New registrant SMSF, taxable or not, unless advised of a 31 October 2026 date at its registration review: lodge and pay by 28 February 2027.

fact_meanings.prior_returns_outstanding: one or more prior year tax returns were outstanding at 30 June 2026
fact_meanings.overdue_returns_lodged_by_31_october: every return outstanding at 30 June 2026 was lodged by 31 October 2026, which restores the program date for the 2026 return
fact_meanings.on_agent_client_list_by_cutoff: the client was on the registered agent's client list by 31 October 2026, so the program covers the 2026 return
fact_meanings.large_or_medium: a large or medium taxpayer as the ATO defines it for return lodgment (for example annual total income over $10 million; for a super fund, also investments over $50 million); for a head company, the group under the single entity rule
fact_meanings.member_large_or_medium: a member of the head company's consolidated group was large or medium in its latest year lodged
fact_meanings.new_registrant: a new registrant with no earlier return
fact_meanings.prior_year_return_taxable: the 2025 return (the latest year lodged) was taxable
fact_meanings.current_year_return_taxable: the 2026 return being lodged will be taxable
fact_meanings.latest_tax_liability_20k_or_more: the latest return lodged resulted in a tax liability of $20,000 or more
fact_meanings.total_income_over_2m: total income was over $2 million both in 2024–25 and in the latest year lodged (for a head company, a member's); null when the 2 differ or are not known, because ATO pages name each year
fact_meanings.prior_year_non_taxable_or_refund: the prior year return was non-taxable or resulted in a refund
fact_meanings.current_year_non_taxable_or_refund: the 2026 return will be non-taxable or result in a refund
fact_meanings.consolidated_head_company: the company is the head company of a consolidated group
fact_meanings.first_consolidated_return: this is the group's first consolidated return
fact_meanings.lodges_electronically: the statement is lodged electronically: for a self-lodger, received and lodged online; for an agent, lodged through Online services for agents or the practitioner lodgment service
fact_meanings.previous_statement_lodged_electronically: each statement generates after the client's previous activity statement was lodged electronically; false for a first statement, a paper one or one lodged after the next statement generated
fact_meanings.includes_monthly_payg_obligation: the quarterly statement also carries a monthly PAYG withholding or PAYG instalment obligation
fact_meanings.annual_turnover_up_to_10m: annual turnover is up to $10 million
fact_meanings.deferred_gst_registered: the business is registered for deferred GST
fact_meanings.on_fbt_client_list_by_21_may: the tax agent was appointed for the client's FBT role and had the client on its FBT client list by 21 May
